latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release: "Video Trimmer High — Trim and Export HD Videos".
- Upload raw MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and describe how you'd like them trimmed.
- AI-based precision trimming via text instructions; process and export to 1080p MP4 in under 2 minutes.
- Designed for quick, slider-free workflow — no manual editing suite required.
- Integrated cloud render pipeline, session handling, and automatic credit/token management.
- Supports common video/audio/image formats and provides real-time status updates during editing and export.
